definitions.explanation: A warm dipping sauce for tempura, made from {出汁|だし}, soy sauce, and mirin. Usually served with grated daikon stirred in.

examples.japanese: {天|てん}つゆ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけて→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: Dip it in tempura sauce and eat it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大根|だいこん}おろし→大根おろし：26890_daikonoroshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{天|てん}つゆ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: Stir grated daikon into the tempura sauce.

examples.japanese: {天|てん}つゆ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧、しょうゆ、みりん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせれば→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}れる→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Tempura sauce is easy to make at home by combining dashi, soy sauce, and mirin.

notes:
Standard accompaniment to tempura, served warm in a small bowl. The basic ratio is roughly 4:1:1 (⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧:soy sauce:mirin), though recipes vary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天|てん}つゆ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to dip in tempura sauce
- ⟦{大根|だいこん}おろし→大根おろし：26890_daikonoroshi⟧{入|い}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{天|てん}つゆ: tempura sauce with grated daikon
- {天|てん}つゆ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make tempura sauce

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧: salt — the other classic tempura accompaniment
- そばつゆ: soba broth/dipping sauce — similar base, used for soba
